title: Detailed teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/base glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#5a2e1a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='81' rx='28' ry='4.5' fill='#f5dfc0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ffc080' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body bottom band -->
  <path d='M22 66 Q50 82 78 66 Q78 74 50 80 Q22 74 22 66Z' fill='#d07830'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q10 46 8 36 Q16 38 22 44' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <path d='M10 38 Q14 40 18 44' fill='none' stroke='#ffc080' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='9' cy='35' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M78 46 Q94 44 92 62 Q90 74 78 72' fill='none' stroke='#f0a050' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 46 Q90 46 89 60 Q88 71 78 70' fill='none' stroke='#ffc080' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- lid rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <!-- lid dome -->
  <path d='M32 37 Q34 24 50 22 Q66 24 68 37' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <path d='M38 33 Q40 28 50 27' fill='none' stroke='#ffc080' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='4' fill='#d07830'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#ffc080'/>
  <!-- decorative pattern on body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='16' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#d07830' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4' fill='#d07830'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#f0a050'/>
  <!-- little dots pattern -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#d07830'/>
  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M38 18 Q34 12 38 6' fill='none' stroke='#c0e0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M50 16 Q46 10 50 4' fill='none' stroke='#c0e0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 18 Q58 12 62 6' fill='none' stroke='#c0e0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
